name: Kochou Getsuden - Tsukishiro no Shou -
source:
Those with the ability to bestow auspicious omens, Futatsu Hane.
An Eastern historical fantasy-themed,
auspicious omen bestowal simulation game.
Enjoy the various episodes and outcomes of the protagonist Haru, who clumsily runs about in the troublesome world of auspicious omen bestowal, and the people who watch over him.
translation:
有赐吉祥能力的人，二羽羽。
以东方历史奇幻为主题，
吉祥赐福模拟游戏。
请尽情享受在吉兆的麻烦世界里笨拙地奔跑的主人公Haru和守护他的人们的各种情节和结局。
